scope: B13 one-notice B03 delivery and populated permanent commitment retention
classification: synthetic local Node/D1; no external transport
semantics: One known notice per immutable job payload; exact canonical job business/source identity.
Notice-specific lease remains delivery authority; optional B03 job+execution fences additionally gate all notice mutations.
Exact live notice token checkpoint precedes delivery; failed checkpoint never finishes; replay resumes retained token.

Expired notice lease becomes unknown then reconciles before later new attempt; current private scope needed for new lease/delivery, mandatory reconciliation remains possible under revoked notification scope.
Wrong notice, stolen/expired job, missing execution fence and revoked runner cannot mutate.
Already committed delivery replay is read-only even after revocation/stale job, and never recreates deleted inbox.
Cancellation/expiry reports cancelled rather than delivered; optional pause returns retry.
Populated golden awards/allocations/boards/public manifest catalog and genuinely recorded private artifact receipt/object remain byte-for-byte unchanged after notice purge.
